sentences.en: The coach made the players run five miles a day.
sentences.zh: 教练每天让球员们跑五英里。

sentences.en: A good coach is like a parent to the players.
sentences.zh: 一个好的教练就像球员们的父母。

sentences.en: The last three coaches of the train were badly damaged.
sentences.zh: 长途汽车的最后一节车厢严重损坏了。
